definitions.explanation: The act of accepting, receiving, or admitting someone or something. Used for people (refugees, patients, students) as well as abstract concepts (proposals, conditions).

examples.japanese: ⟦{難民|なんみん}→難民：05313_nanmin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受|う}け{入|い}れ。
⟦{留学生|りゅうがくせい}→留学生：02986_ryuugakusei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受|う}け{入|い}れ⟦{体制|たいせい}→体制：04490_taisei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧。
examples.english: To prepare a system for accepting international students.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受|う}け{入|い}れなし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{進|すす}められない→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: This plan cannot proceed without acceptance from local residents.

notes:
The nominal form of the verb {受|う}け{入|い}れる (to accept). Very commonly used as a noun modifier in compound expressions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {受|う}け{入|い}れ⟦{態勢|たいせい}→態勢：12937_taisei⟧: acceptance system/setup
- {受|う}け{入|い}れ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧: receiving party; host institution
- {受|う}け{入|い}れ⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧: acceptable; able to be accepted
- ⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受|う}け{入|い}れ: admission of patients
- ⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受|う}け{入|い}れ: acceptance of conditions

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{受容|じゅよう}→受容：11948_juyou⟧: acceptance — more abstract and literary; used in psychology and academic contexts
- ⟦{承認|しょうにん}→承認：03237_shounin⟧: approval — implies formal authorization, not just acceptance
- ⟦{容認|ようにん}→容認：12344_younin⟧: tolerance; tacit approval — accepting something reluctantly or without opposing it

REGISTER:
Neutral to slightly formal. Very common in news, policy discussions, and institutional contexts.
